comments.body: The collab layer already has the dual versions—UI is the missing piece. Spike branch renders a basic split view.

content.text: The collab layer already has the dual versions—UI is the missing piece. Spike branch renders a basic split view.
When two people edit the same paragraph, the last writer often overwrites the other with only a coarse “conflict” toast. Users want to see both versions before choosing.

If presence detects concurrent edits on the same block_id, show an inline diff gutter: remote insertions in one highlight, local in another, with Accept mine / Accept theirs / Merge line-by-line actions. Diffs are character-level for short paragraphs and line-level above 280 characters.
Ready when conflicts no longer auto-apply remote wins, analytics track merge outcomes, and the flow works for at least two simultaneous peers on a single block.
